homepage.title: homepage
homepage.resolution: All 6 defects fixed and production-verified (PR #38 merge fbc6408, PR #39 merge 0d8afd3). Hero right corners rounded (the edge-fade overlay had no border-radius); publisher marquee constrained to the cover stack; hover-enlarged rail cards no longer clipped (0px top/bottom); Series is real primary nav plus a footer link; mobile UK/US toggle removed - it blanked all 12 prices because every deal has lowestPriceUSD null; rail relabelled "Cheapest tracked retailer - eBay may be lower" because the rail MINs stored retailer_listings and eBay is live-only; canonical/og/sitemap moved to the www host that actually serves 200. Launch smoke 20/20, Browser Trust 13/0/3 against production. Awaiting founder re-review to move to good.
homepage.openFollowUp: P0 raised, not built (founder chose plan-first): /api/ebay merges an unfiltered fuzzy title search whenever the ISBN lookup returns fewer than 3 hits, so /product/hellboy-omnibus-706665 lists Hellboy Omnibus Vol 2 and a B.P.R.D. book at the TOP of its price table at GBP 10.80 - a different book presented as the cheapest offer. Plan: launch/product-excellence/ebay-relevance-gate-plan.md
